item.title: Valentia Coast Guard assisting French fishing vessel off Dingle coast
item.description: Valentia Coast Guard and rescue helicopter 115 are currently on the scene at Binn Bán beach near Dingle Lighthouse after a French fishing boat got into difficulty off the coast. Dingle Coast Guard and Valentia Life Boats are also assisting in the operation. Advertisement No injuries have been reported.

item.title: FSI cites complex Kerry murder trial and record crystal meth seizure in annual report
item.description: Forensic Science Ireland has referenced two Kerry criminal cases as case studies in its latest annual report. FSI is an executive agency of the Department of Justice, delivering a scientific service to support the Irish criminal justice system by analysing samples gathered at crime scenes. FSI’s latest annual report cites its work in analysing 540kg of crystal meth, and its DNA work in the Thomas Dooley murder trial, as case studies. item.title: Two Kerry siblings among recipients at MTU Student Awards
item.description: Two Kerry siblings were among the recipients of the MTU Kerry Student Awards. The annual awards recognize the exceptional achievements of students during the academic year. This year’s Tom McEllistrim Award was presented to the student with the highest Leaving Certificate points within the eligible programme areas. item.title: Several events cancelled due to orange rain warning
item.description: Several festive events in the county have been cancelled due to the current weather warning. A status orange rain warning will remain in the place for the county until 6 o'clock this evening. The Island of Geese Christmas Market, due to take place this afternoon, has been cancelled due to the weather. item.title: Crew of French fishing vessel brought to shore in multi-agency effort
item.description: Valentia Coast Guard and rescue helicopter 115 were on the scene at Binn Bán beach near Dingle Lighthouse earlier this afternoon after a French fishing boat got into difficulty off the coast. The fishing vessel went aground leaving Dingle, with 14 persons on board. Rescue helicopter 115 winched the 14 people ashore. Valentia Coast Guard's fixed wing plane was also at the scene. item.title: Cromane Lose To Muckalee In All-Ireland Final
item.description: Cromane came within seconds of forcing extra-time but instead lost by a point in the AIB All-Ireland Ladies Junior Club Football Final. They were beaten by Muckalee of Kilkenny on a scoreline of 1-13 to 2-09 at Parnell Park. Cromane Manager Anne-Marie O'Donoghue gave her reaction to Dan Kearney afterwards. Advertisement

item.title: Victories For Villa, Sunderland, Forest, City
item.description: An Erling Haaland brace with goals either side of a Phil Foden strike gave Manchester City all three points at Selhurst Park. The 3-0 win moves them to within 2 points of Arsenal at the top of the Premier League. Sunderland have beaten rivals Newcastle 1-nil in the Premier League. Advertisement Nick Woltemade's ((Pron: Volt-eh-mah-duh)) own goal saw the hosts claim victory and move up to seventh. item.title: 13% would like to see Norma Foley succeed Micheál Martin as Taoiseach
item.description: 13% of voters would like to see Minister for Children, Disability and Equality and Kerry TD Norma Foley succeed Micheál Martin as Taoiseach. The poll in today's Irish Mail on Sunday was based on the responses of 1,000 people canvassed between December 5th and 9th. Minister Foley has the highest preference from those aged 45 to 54, at 19%, and had a 17% preference among 18 to 24 year olds. item.title: St Mirren Sink Celtic To Win Scottish League Cup
item.description: St Mirren have beaten Celtic 3-1 in a Scottish League Cup final upset. Jonah Ayunga's second half double ensured the Paisley side lifted the trophy for the first time since 2013. Defeat for Celtic is a third in a row since new boss Wilfried Nancy took charge. Advertisement Robert McElroy reports from Hampden Park.
